code_python:
letters = {"А": "00", "Б": "01", "У": "11",
           "Л": "1000", "Ь": "1001", 
           "К": "1010", "Р": "1011"}

word = "БАБУЛЬКА"
res = 0
for letter in word:
    res += len(letters[letter])
print(res)
